entities.name: ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE-MM
entities.description: UE state where it attempts to update mobility management, performs cell selection/reselection, and can initiate tracking area updating procedures.

entities.name: Combined tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE indicating 'combined TA/LA updating with IMSI attach' when specific timers expire or tracking area conditions are met.

entities.name: T3411
entities.description: Timer whose expiry triggers initiation of combined tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: T3402
entities.description: Timer related to congestion control; when running, restricts certain non-EPS service requests unless for emergency calls.

entities.name: T3444
entities.description: Timer whose expiry triggers eCall inactivity procedure in eCall only mode.

entities.name: T3445
entities.description: Timer whose expiry triggers eCall inactivity procedure in eCall only mode.

entities.name: UE enters tracking area not in registered list and not forbidden
entities.description: Condition triggering combined tracking area updating procedure when UE moves to an unregistered and non-forbidden tracking area.

entities.name: Emergency call request
entities.description: Condition allowing non-EPS service requests for emergency calls even when T3402 is running due to congestion.

entities.name: eCall only mode configured
entities.description: Condition where UE is configured for eCall only mode, enabling eCall inactivity procedure on timer expiry.

entities.name: eCall inactivity procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed at expiry of T3444 or T3445 when UE is in eCall only mode.

entities.name: Respond to paging with IMSI or S-TMSI
entities.description: UE behavior to respond to paging for PS domain using IMSI or S-TMSI, with optional MUSIM implementation exceptions.

entities.name: Handle non-EPS service requests
entities.description: UE behavior to use requests for non-EPS services to select GERAN/UTRAN and proceed with MM/CC procedures, unless restricted by T3402 running for congestion.

relations.description: UE in ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE-MM state initiates combined tracking area updating procedure under specified conditions.
UE in ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE-MM state shall respond to paging with IMSI or S-TMSI for PS domain.
UE in ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE-MM state handles non-EPS service requests to select GERAN/UTRAN and proceed with MM/CC procedures.
Condition of entering unregistered and non-forbidden tracking area guards initiation of combined tracking area updating procedure.
Expiry of timer T3411 starts combined tracking area updating procedure.
Expiry of timer T3402 starts combined tracking area updating procedure.
Emergency call condition guards non-EPS service request behavior, allowing it even when T3402 is running.
eCall only mode condition guards execution of eCall inactivity procedure.
Expiry of timer T3444 starts eCall inactivity procedure.
Expiry of timer T3445 starts eCall inactivity procedure.
